args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed production health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after its latest deploy. Per the runbook, rolled back all production regions to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate 0.2%. v2.3.1 must not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done:

1. **Investigated**: v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (the intermediate v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and also unhealthy, so it was not a candidate).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure, the rollback, and post-rollback health.
